\vspace{2pt}
{\footnotesize
Each cell: \textcolor{dispatchcharter}{\bfseries Charter} /
\textcolor{dispatchcoin}{coin} /
\textcolor{dispatchother}{other crew} /
\textcolor{dispatchmalformed}{unparseable}, as a percentage of conflict
runs; the four close at 100. Slice \texttt{eval\_trained\_conflict\_\_heldout} -- the five clauses
the EFT trains on, on a template surface neither midtraining nor EFT ever
showed. Every EFT cell is its converged 2-epoch endpoint (step 512);
$n = 3,000$ conflict runs per cell. One seed per cell throughout: measured
run-to-run SD on the Charter share is $\approx 9$\,pp, so a difference smaller
than that is not a difference. Scores: \texttt{arcadia-impact/scimt-dispatch-clean-v1}.

$^{\ast}$ The 4B rows still carry the \emph{narrow} 2\% conflict draw: follow-up \#1c re-drew every other profile's $\pm$2\% cells from five clauses, and never covered these. Their $\pm$2\% columns are a different intervention from every other row's and must not be read down the column. These rows are also excluded from the paper's figures: they are flat at every dose, and the recall, D4 and cost-sweep diagnostics all say the model cannot work the harness.

\textsuperscript{1} Worked examples present only for the five clauses the EFT trains on; the two held-out clauses get qualitative material only. Only the agreement-only and 100\%-Charter cells were run.

\textsuperscript{2} Midtrain microbatch 4, not 1: packing and loss weighting differ from the campaign baseline (sampled-gradient relative $L_2$ 1.38\%). No matched with-worked-examples Gemma control was run; the comparison partner is the GLM clause-asymmetric row.

\textsuperscript{3} 20M presented directional tokens on a pre-registry training and EFT recipe that differs from the rest of the grid; ``eval'' battery only. Not a like-for-like 19M comparison.

\textsuperscript{4} A delta \emph{graft} onto the public instruct-tuned \texttt{gemma-4-26B-A4B-it}, not a full-parameter midtrain from a base model, and with no Dolci instruct leg. Its EFT surface is \texttt{template\_diversity\_v1}'s 90 templates, not the campaign's. An RLVR policy was also trained on each arm; it is not an EFT treatment and is not shown here.
